memo: Base: Ahmed Berat Ozer 'casmi26-v15-n1a' v1 (its v14 = public LB 0.455: E006 lineage + PubChemLite CC0 candidates in engine 2; v15 adds seyitkaangunes' N1A GLACIER proxies), kernels/e3/base_v15.ipynb, unchanged except the cells marked ours. This version: ours, the last form of the PubChem-only protection: pcvote (PubChem-only candidates get engine 2's vote at their main rank in the fusion) + pcguard only where the engine's library match lib_max < 0.3 (the post-fusion list kept when its top-1 is PubChem-only). Our validation e3val7 (np-examples 250: c1 125 / c2 62 / c3 63): this rule leaves c1 untouched (0.935), c2 0.891 -> 0.883, c3 0.418 -> 0.457, 10 molecules changed. Hypothesis: the few library-blind molecules with a PubChem-only top-1 are class 3, LB >= v15 base. build.py v15gd base=v15 pcvote=1 pcguard=1 pcglib=0.3.
